name: qrCodeGenerate
description: Generates a QR code encoding the given text and returns it as a Binary of encoded image bytes. The module grid is drawn at the largest whole-pixel scale that fits the requested size and then nearest-neighbour resized to hit size on the nose (scaling a QR with a smoothing filter blurs the module edges and can make it unreadable). size is the target edge length in pixels (the result is square, clamped to 16-4096); format is any format the image BIFs write (png, gif, jpg, bmp, webp, ...); errorCorrection is L, M, Q or H; quietZone is the light margin in modules (the QR spec requires 4).

params.name: text
params.description: The text to encode. Required and must be non-empty.

params.name: size
params.description: Target edge length in pixels (the result is square). Clamped to 16-4096.

params.name: format
params.description: Image format of the encoded output: png, gif, jpg, bmp, webp, tiff or ico.

params.name: errorCorrection
params.description: Error-correction level: L, M, Q or H — the proportion of the symbol that can be damaged and still decode.

params.name: quietZone
params.description: The mandatory light margin, in modules (the QR spec requires 4). Clamped to 0-32.

examples.title: Generate a QR code PNG
examples.description: Encode a URL and write the 250px PNG to disk.

examples.title: GIF with high error correction
examples.description: A 125px GIF with H error correction, suitable for printing.
